description: This Java source file defines the `DrawableTintingFragment` class, an Android Fragment that demonstrates tinting of Drawable resources both programmatically and in XML. It provides UI controls such as SeekBars and a Spinner to adjust color components (ARGB) and blending modes, updating the appearance of an ImageView dynamically.

classes.name: DrawableTintingFragment
classes.description: An Android Fragment class that showcases tinting Drawables with adjustable color and blend modes through a UI.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the fragment, setting options menu visibility.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Inflates layout, initializes UI components, restores state, and sets up event listeners.

methods.name: onSaveInstanceState
methods.description: Saves UI state related to color components and blend mode.

methods.name: getColor
methods.description: Computes ARGB color from SeekBar progress values.

methods.name: getTintMode
methods.description: Returns the currently selected PorterDuff blending mode.

methods.name: updateTint
methods.description: Applies the selected color and blending mode to the ImageView.
